panorama_rotundas.name: Panorama Rotundas
panorama_rotundas.observation: Paying visitors stand in a round hall surrounded by a painted view of a far city or a famous battle.

reading_circles.name: Reading Circles
reading_circles.observation: Clubs of the middling sort pool their money to buy and pass round books and papers.

gymnastics_grounds.name: Gymnastics Grounds
gymnastics_grounds.observation: Open grounds with bars and ropes train the young in strength and drill.

historical_novel.name: Historical Novel
historical_novel.observation: Long novels bring the realm's own past to life for ordinary readers.

civic_concert_halls.name: Civic Concert Halls
civic_concert_halls.observation: Public halls with paid orchestras give concerts to anyone with a ticket.

home_art_songs.name: Home Art Songs
home_art_songs.observation: Families sing songs for voice and piano in the parlour.

comparative_philology.name: Comparative Philology
comparative_philology.observation: Scholars trace related tongues back to a common ancestor.

temperance_societies.name: Temperance Societies
temperance_societies.observation: Societies preach against strong drink and gather pledges of abstinence.
temperance_societies.social_consequence: Drinkers and publicans resent the preachers; families quarrel over the pledge.

grand_opera_houses.name: Grand Opera Houses
grand_opera_houses.observation: Grand opera houses stage spectacles for the town public.

national_tongue_revival.name: National Tongue Revival
national_tongue_revival.observation: Scholars give the people's tongue a standard grammar and a literature of its own.

god_revival_meetings.name: Revival Meetings
god_revival_meetings.observation: Preachers of the god hold great open-air meetings where crowds are moved to repentance.

cheap_daily_press.name: Cheap Daily Press
cheap_daily_press.observation: Cheap daily papers are sold on every street corner and read by clerks and labourers.
cheap_daily_press.ability_reason: News reaches ordinary people every day; public opinion becomes something ministers answer to.
cheap_daily_press.social_consequence: Scandal sells papers; ministers are judged in print by people who never met them.

serialized_novels.name: Serialized Novels
serialized_novels.observation: Novels come out in weekly parts, and whole families wait for the next one.

portrait_photo_studios.name: Portrait Photo Studios
portrait_photo_studios.observation: Studios take likenesses of ordinary families for a small fee.

political_cartoon_weeklies.name: Political Cartoon Weeklies
political_cartoon_weeklies.observation: Satirical weeklies mock ministers with drawings anyone can understand.

family_winter_feast.name: Family Winter Feast
family_winter_feast.observation: Families gather for a winter feast with gifts, greeting cards and a lit tree.

realist_novel.name: Realist Novel
realist_novel.observation: Novels depict the lives of ordinary people as they really are.

common_ownership_doctrine.name: Common Ownership Doctrine
common_ownership_doctrine.observation: A doctrine says the workers should own the factories and the land in common.
common_ownership_doctrine.social_consequence: Owners fear revolution; workers organize around a promise of a different order.

national_unity_movements.name: National Unity Movements
national_unity_movements.observation: Movements demand one realm for one people speaking one tongue.
national_unity_movements.ability_reason: A people's shared tongue and history become the ground of loyalty; generals can call on national feeling.
national_unity_movements.social_consequence: Minorities who speak other tongues are pressed to conform, or treated as foreigners.

womens_rights_convention.name: Women's Rights Convention
womens_rights_convention.observation: A convention declares that women are owed the same rights as men.

sacred_text_criticism.name: Sacred Text Criticism
sacred_text_criticism.observation: Scholars study the sacred texts as documents with their own history.
sacred_text_criticism.social_consequence: The faithful are shaken; some priests of the god lose their congregations.

great_realms_exhibition.name: Great Realms Exhibition
great_realms_exhibition.observation: A great glass hall displays the works and machines of all realms to millions of visitors.
great_realms_exhibition.ability_reason: Inventors, buyers and the public see the newest machines of every realm under one roof.

excursion_tourism.name: Excursion Tourism
excursion_tourism.observation: Trains take townspeople on cheap excursions to the seaside.

war_photography.name: War Photography
war_photography.observation: Photographs from the war reach the public at home.
war_photography.social_consequence: The dead on the field are seen by families at home, and war loses its glamour.

mountain_climbing_clubs.name: Mountain Climbing Clubs
mountain_climbing_clubs.observation: Clubs climb the high peaks for sport and map the routes.

codified_ball_games.name: Codified Ball Games
codified_ball_games.observation: Field ball games are given written rules and governing associations.

childrens_books.name: Children's Books
childrens_books.observation: Books are written for children to enjoy.

national_history_lessons.name: National History Lessons
national_history_lessons.observation: Every school teaches the nation's history from one approved textbook.

layered_excavation.name: Layered Excavation
layered_excavation.observation: Excavators dig by layers and date what they find by its depth.

open_air_light_painting.name: Open-air Light Painting
open_air_light_painting.observation: Painters work outdoors to catch the passing light.

variety_music_halls.name: Variety Music Halls
variety_music_halls.observation: Music halls offer songs, comedians and acrobats for a cheap ticket.

recorded_sound.name: Recorded Sound
recorded_sound.observation: Voices and music are recorded on cylinders and discs and played back at will.
recorded_sound.ability_reason: Performance can be kept and sold; music and speech travel without the performer.

brand_advertising.name: Brand Advertising
brand_advertising.observation: Firms sell branded goods through advertising agencies.

monument_protection_law.name: Monument Protection Law
monument_protection_law.observation: A law protects ancient monuments from destruction.

endowed_town_libraries.name: Endowed Town Libraries
endowed_town_libraries.observation: Free libraries are endowed in every town.

professional_sport_leagues.name: Professional Sport Leagues
professional_sport_leagues.observation: Professional players compete in leagues watched by great crowds.

constructed_common_language.name: Constructed Common Language
constructed_common_language.observation: A constructed language is offered as a common tongue for all peoples.

handcraft_revival.name: Handcraft Revival
handcraft_revival.observation: Artists revive hand crafts against the machine.

workers_festival_day.name: Workers' Festival Day
workers_festival_day.observation: Workers march on their own festival day.

mystery_fiction.name: Mystery Fiction
mystery_fiction.observation: Detective stories and mysteries are published in great numbers.

open_air_folk_museum.name: Open-air Folk Museum
open_air_folk_museum.observation: Old farmhouses and workshops are rebuilt in open-air museums.

moving_pictures.name: Moving Pictures
moving_pictures.observation: Moving pictures are shown to paying crowds in darkened halls.
moving_pictures.ability_reason: Stories, news and customs reach whole populations through the same pictures.
moving_pictures.social_consequence: Picture palaces fill every rest-day eve; preachers warn of their influence on the young.

revived_realm_games.name: Revived Realm Games
revived_realm_games.observation: Athletes of all realms meet at revived games every fourth year.

peace_congresses.name: Peace Congresses
peace_congresses.observation: Congresses of citizens from many realms campaign for peace.

million_reader_dailies.name: Million-reader Dailies
million_reader_dailies.observation: Daily papers with a million readers shape public opinion.
million_reader_dailies.social_consequence: Press barons can make and unmake ministers.

great_merit_prizes.name: Great Merit Prizes
great_merit_prizes.observation: Great prizes are awarded for science, letters and peace.

abstract_painting.name: Abstract Painting
abstract_painting.observation: Painters abandon form and paint abstraction.

youth_scouting.name: Youth Scouting
youth_scouting.observation: Youth scouting movements teach woodcraft and duty.

syncopated_dance_music.name: Syncopated Dance Music
syncopated_dance_music.observation: Syncopated dance music from the port cities spreads to every dance hall.

newspaper_puzzles.name: Newspaper Puzzles
newspaper_puzzles.observation: Crosswords and puzzles appear in the daily paper.

war_newsreels_posters.name: War Newsreels and Posters
war_newsreels_posters.observation: War posters and newsreels rally the home front.
war_newsreels_posters.social_consequence: Dissent is drowned out; enlistment surges and enemy peoples are painted as monsters.

ethnographic_fieldwork.name: Ethnographic Fieldwork
ethnographic_fieldwork.observation: Scholars live among other peoples to record their ways.

radio_broadcasting.name: Radio Broadcasting
radio_broadcasting.observation: Radio broadcasts reach every home with news, music and the ruler's voice.
radio_broadcasting.ability_reason: One voice can address the whole people at once; news spreads in minutes.
radio_broadcasting.social_consequence: The ruler speaks into every kitchen; rumour and propaganda travel as fast as news.
radio_broadcasting.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Broadcast Radio Sets from triode valves, tuned circuits, variable capacitors, resistors, capacitors, telephone earpieces, insulated cable and timber, using timber and wrought iron. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

unknown_warrior_remembrance.name: Unknown Warrior Remembrance
unknown_warrior_remembrance.observation: An unknown warrior is buried in a national tomb, and a day of remembrance is kept.

inner_voice_novel.name: Inner-voice Novel
inner_voice_novel.observation: Novels follow the inner stream of a character's thought.

public_broadcasting_charter.name: Public Broadcasting Charter
public_broadcasting_charter.observation: A public broadcasting corporation operates under a charter, independent of the government.

film_studio_system.name: Film Studio System
film_studio_system.observation: Film studios make pictures for the whole world.

sound_films.name: Sound Films
sound_films.observation: Films with synchronized sound replace silent pictures.

world_ball_cup.name: World Ball Cup
world_ball_cup.observation: Realms compete for a world cup of field ball.

leader_mass_rallies.name: Leader Mass Rallies
leader_mass_rallies.observation: Choreographed mass rallies glorify the leader.
leader_mass_rallies.social_consequence: Crowds chant in unison; those who stay home are noted.

mass_paperbacks.name: Mass Paperbacks
mass_paperbacks.observation: Cheap paperback books are sold everywhere.

picture_story_magazines.name: Picture-story Magazines
picture_story_magazines.observation: Picture-story magazines tell adventures in drawn panels.

photo_news_magazines.name: Photo News Magazines
photo_news_magazines.observation: Picture magazines carry the week's news in photographs.

television_broadcasting.name: Television Broadcasting
television_broadcasting.observation: Television broadcasts pictures and sound into the home.
television_broadcasting.ability_reason: Every household sees the same news and entertainment at the same hour.
television_broadcasting.social_consequence: Families gather around the set; evening life moves indoors.

animated_features.name: Animated Features
animated_features.observation: Feature-length animated films are made for all ages.

long_play_records.name: Long-play Records
long_play_records.observation: Long-playing records hold a whole concert.

broadcast_rites.name: Broadcast Rites
broadcast_rites.observation: The god's rites are broadcast into every home.

televised_state_rites.name: Televised State Rites
televised_state_rites.observation: The rites of the seat of rule are televised to the whole realm.

electric_youth_music.name: Electric Youth Music
electric_youth_music.observation: The young play electric guitar music their elders cannot stand.
electric_youth_music.ability_reason: A culture of the young spreads across realms through records and radio.
electric_youth_music.social_consequence: Parents despair; the young take their own fashions and manners.

mass_television_age.name: Mass Television Age
mass_television_age.observation: Television sits in most homes and fills the evenings.

charter_flight_holidays.name: Charter Flight Holidays
charter_flight_holidays.observation: Charter flights take the many on holidays abroad.

mass_image_art.name: Mass Image Art
mass_image_art.observation: Artists make art from mass-produced images.

televised_debates.name: Televised Debates
televised_debates.observation: Candidates for office debate on television.

nonviolent_rights_movements.name: Nonviolent Rights Movements
nonviolent_rights_movements.observation: Mass nonviolent movements demand civil rights.
nonviolent_rights_movements.ability_reason: Excluded groups win rights by marches and sit-ins rather than arms.
nonviolent_rights_movements.social_consequence: Marchers face beatings and arrest; the realm is divided until the law changes.

worldwide_live_broadcast.name: Worldwide Live Broadcast
worldwide_live_broadcast.observation: A live broadcast is shared by the whole world at once.

youth_counterculture.name: Youth Counterculture
youth_counterculture.observation: Students protest and a youth counterculture rejects the old ways.
youth_counterculture.social_consequence: Universities are occupied; parents and children no longer understand one another.

womens_liberation_movement.name: Women's Liberation Movement
womens_liberation_movement.observation: A women's liberation movement demands equality at work and at home.

many_cultures_policy.name: Many Cultures Policy
many_cultures_policy.observation: Policy honours many cultures within one realm.

electronic_games.name: Electronic Games
electronic_games.observation: Electronic games are played on screens.

world_heritage_list.name: World Heritage List
world_heritage_list.observation: A world list protects the great cultural sites.

home_video_recording.name: Home Video Recording
home_video_recording.observation: Families record television and their own films at home.

portable_music_players.name: Portable Music Players
portable_music_players.observation: Portable music players give each listener their own music.

spoken_rhythm_music.name: Spoken-rhythm Music
spoken_rhythm_music.observation: Spoken-rhythm music comes from the city streets.

continuous_news_channels.name: Continuous News Channels
continuous_news_channels.observation: News channels broadcast around the clock.

digital_music_discs.name: Digital Music Discs
digital_music_discs.observation: Music is sold on digital discs.

benefit_broadcast_concerts.name: Benefit Broadcast Concerts
benefit_broadcast_concerts.observation: Benefit concerts are broadcast around the world to raise money for the starving.

online_forums.name: Online Forums
online_forums.observation: Online forums and personal web pages let anyone publish.

file_sharing_networks.name: File Sharing Networks
file_sharing_networks.observation: Music and films are shared freely across networks.

online_social_networks.name: Online Social Networks
online_social_networks.observation: Online social networks link friends and strangers across the world.
online_social_networks.ability_reason: Every person can reach and be reached by thousands; opinion forms in hours.
online_social_networks.social_consequence: Private life becomes public; quarrels and rumours spread faster than the court can answer them.

user_video_sharing.name: User Video Sharing
user_video_sharing.observation: Users share their own videos with the world.

streaming_media.name: Streaming Media
streaming_media.observation: Music and films are streamed on demand.

networked_protest_movements.name: Networked Protest Movements
networked_protest_movements.observation: Protests are organized over networks within hours.

algorithmic_feeds.name: Algorithmic Feeds
algorithmic_feeds.observation: Algorithmic feeds decide what each person sees.
algorithmic_feeds.social_consequence: People see only what keeps them watching; neighbours stop sharing the same facts.

networked_disinformation.name: Networked Disinformation
networked_disinformation.observation: Organized disinformation campaigns flood the networks.
networked_disinformation.social_consequence: Trust in the court, the press and the physicians erodes; no report is believed without a fight.

short_viral_video.name: Short Viral Video
short_viral_video.observation: Short videos and shared image jokes spread in hours.

online_influencers.name: Online Influencers
online_influencers.observation: Livestream performers and influencers gather millions of followers.

remote_video_gatherings.name: Remote Video Gatherings
remote_video_gatherings.observation: Work, worship and school are carried on by video call.

generated_media.name: Generated Media
generated_media.observation: Learned models generate images and music on request.
generated_media.ability_reason: Anyone can make pictures, music and voices by asking a machine.
generated_media.social_consequence: No picture or recording can be trusted on sight; artists see their styles copied without payment.

media_provenance_marks.name: Media Provenance Marks
media_provenance_marks.observation: Photographs and recordings carry verified marks of where they came from.

shared_virtual_venues.name: Shared Virtual Venues
shared_virtual_venues.observation: People gather in shared virtual venues for concerts and meetings.
